command:# Reports live under temporary-docs/gnomish/<task>/: the task branch's name without its
# gnomish/ prefix (the factory's own sanitized taskId), 'local' off a task branch.
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
report=$dir/review-artifacts.md
if [ ! -f "$report" ]; then
  echo "no review report at $report - write it before finishing the round, see .gnomish/stages/review-artifacts/instructions.md"
  exit 1
fi

command:# Reports live under temporary-docs/gnomish/<task>/: the task branch's name without its
# gnomish/ prefix (the factory's own sanitized taskId), 'local' off a task branch.
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
report=$dir/review-artifacts.md
expected=$(sed -n 's/^Change:[[:space:]]*//p' $dir/change.md | head -1)
change=$(sed -n 's/^## Artifacts Review:[[:space:]]*//p' "$report" | head -1 | tr -d '`')
if [ "$change" != "$expected" ]; then
  echo "the report's '## Artifacts Review:' heading names '$change', but $dir/change.md cleared '$expected' - review that change and name it exactly"
  exit 1
fi
for section in '### Summary' '### Landed since' '### Freshness' '### Coverage matrix' '### Completeness' '### Internal consistency' '### External consistency' '### Recommendations, ordered' '### Verdict'; do
  grep -q "^$section" "$report" || { echo "the report has no '$section' section - keep the layout of step 6 of .claude/commands/review-artifacts.md"; exit 1; }
done
section() { awk -v heading="$1" 'index($0, heading) == 1 { inside = 1; next } /^##/ { inside = 0 } inside' "$report"; }
recommendations=$(section '### Recommendations, ordered')
items=$(printf '%s\n' "$recommendations" | grep -cE '^[0-9]+\. \*\*(CRITICAL|WARNING|SUGGESTION) — ' || true)
for field in Problem Impact Fix 'Fix risk'; do
  count=$(printf '%s\n' "$recommendations" | grep -cE "^[[:space:]]+$field: " || true)
  if [ "$count" != "$items" ]; then
    echo "Recommendations has $items item(s) of the form 'N. **SEVERITY — title** (\`location\`)' but $count indented '$field:' line(s) - every item carries one Problem, Impact, Fix and Fix risk line each, as .claude/rules/review-recommendations.md shows"
    exit 1
  fi
done
# The verdict is what the next stage acts on, so it follows from the severities
# (the command's own rule) rather than standing beside them as a second opinion.
# Emphasis and case are tolerated: a usable verdict is not worth a round over markup.
verdict=$(section '### Verdict' | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' | head -1 | tr -d '*_`' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
blocking=$(printf '%s\n' "$recommendations" | grep -cE '^[0-9]+\. \*\*(CRITICAL|WARNING) — ' || true)
case "$verdict" in
  "needs revision"*) [ "$blocking" -gt 0 ] || { echo "the Verdict reads 'needs revision' but no recommendation is CRITICAL or WARNING - the Verdict opens with 'ready to implement'"; exit 1; } ;;
  "ready to implement"*) [ "$blocking" -eq 0 ] || { echo "there are $blocking CRITICAL/WARNING recommendation(s), so the Verdict opens with 'needs revision', not 'ready to implement'"; exit 1; } ;;
  *) echo "the Verdict section opens with '$verdict'; it must open with exactly 'ready to implement' or 'needs revision'"; exit 1 ;;
esac

command:# Reports live under temporary-docs/gnomish/<task>/: the task branch's name without its
# gnomish/ prefix (the factory's own sanitized taskId), 'local' off a task branch.
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
report=$dir/review-artifacts.md
allowed="$dir/change.md
$report"
dirty=$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | sed 's/^...//' | grep -vxF "$allowed" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
if [ -n "$dirty" ]; then
  echo "this stage writes only $report, but the working copy also carries:"
  echo "$dirty"
  echo "if you made these edits, undo each of them yourself and nothing else."
  echo "if you did not: they are someone else's work in progress. Leave every one of them exactly as it is - do not stash, restore, checkout or clean anything - and escalate through \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE naming the paths."
  exit 1
fi
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in
  gnomish/*)
    if base=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD 2>/dev/null); then
      committed=$(git diff --name-only "$base" HEAD | grep -vxF "$allowed" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
      if [ -n "$committed" ]; then
        echo "the branch carries committed changes no stage so far had any business making:"
        echo "$committed"
        exit 1
      fi
    fi
    ;;
esac

findings.message: R2: revise — fails test 4 (Fix risk not honest / Fix not buildable as written). The enforcement clause proposes extending the StallingGitOwnerSpec scan with the pattern 'a script literal that appends "$@"/$* to a file' and names only GitVersionCheckSpec as an exemption; in the current tree that pattern also hits BaseRefreshSpec.groovy:267, FetchRefusalOutcomeSpec.groovy:199 and RemoteDefaultBranchSpec.groovy:147 (each 'echo "$@" >> file' then 'exec git "$@"' — decision stand-ins over the real binary, not D1-shaped recorders). The stated Fix risk 'widens the scan's allowlist by one file' is therefore wrong by at least three files. Keep the Problem, Impact, the D1 / design.md:156 edits and the rewiring of GitProcessRunnerTransferSpec.recordingRunner(); replace the enforcement pattern with one that matches only the D1 shape (records and always exits 0, never delegates to git) or list every file it would hit as exemptions, and correct the Fix risk accordingly.
